chapter: Early bands, Calloway to Basie and Kansas City (third typescript)
title: Best bands he worked in and the honour of being in Basie's band
summary: He names Speed Webb and Thamon Hayes among the best bands and says he was honored to be in Basie's band.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving

blocks.x: is -- had a chance to play none of these things you know. And they had to go experimenting again. You know -- while
You mentioned the Speed Love band (PHONETIC) as one of the best --
What other bands would you say were particularly good?
Thamon Hayes band. That was a good band.

Probably the most -- the one that became the most famous was the Basie band during the time when you were in it -- that has sort of become a legendary band. Well do you feel that that was one of the high points up to then of your playing career -- being in that band. Or was it just --

Yeah, I was very honored to be in that band. Yeah. And I did have a ball while I was in there. I was playing with some of the guys that were really great, you know. And there were -- lots of greatness dead or alive you know. Like prayers, you know.
